title: On a phone, show that the vitals grid has more columns (Trend) to the right, with an affordance outside the cells
evidence: From PR 1712 (dropped). On main at 390, H79's snap opens the vitals grid at scrollLeft 0 (widget-src/src/lib/useValuePage.ts:86 floors max scroll to whole columns, and max is under one column), with Trend just off screen to the right; scrollbars are hidden, so nothing says the grid scrolls. A right-edge fade was tried in PR 1712 and dropped: after H79's whole-column snap it can only land on the New column, so it dimmed a chat value waiting for review. The affordance must sit outside the cells (for example beside or above the grid), never over a value. Design note with a mock first. needs_brad turns yes if the affordance adds words. The fade was dropped (PR 1712), and the mandatory snap was dropped (PR 1732, closed). Related: H105 (clipped sliver), H79 (column snap). (H106)
